title: 生命科学
subtitle: Bioscience
educationalGoal: Students will learn: (1) the history of bioscience. (2) evolution (From Darwin to Kimura). (3) biotechnology and bioengineering. (4) concepts of green innovation.
advice: This is a bioscience course. We will cover the following topics: 1. Bioscience 2. Evolution 3. Biotechnology 4. Green innovation 5. Bioengineering Students will also learn about advanced issues such as metabolism maps. Students are expected to understand the basics of biosciences. Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms. Students are expected to solve the exercises independently. Students should pay attention to the teacher’s instructions in the class because the schedules for quizzes, tests and reports may change as the class progresses. Students should attend all classes as the handouts may not be received.
books: Textbooks:None (Textbook prepared by the instructors) Reference books:None Reserved books:None
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of basic biology, structure and function in physiology, structure and function of the cell, molecular biology, cell biology, neuroscience and sensory information. Students will review the above courses before starting this course.

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain the history of bioscience from Darwin’s theory.
Ability to explain bioengineering skills (new biotechnology).
